senses.gloss:
Neṣṭṛ, the name of one of the chief priests at the soma sacrifice, occurs in the Rigveda and later. See ṛtvij.
Foot notes i. 15, 3; ii. 5, 5, etc.
taittirīya Saṃhitā, i. 8, 18, 1; vi. 5, 8, 5. 6; aitareya brāhmaṇa, vi. 3, 10, etc.; Śatapatha brāhmaṇa, iii. 8, 2, 1, etc.; pañcaviṃśa brāhmaṇa, xxv. 15, etc.
Cf. Hillebrandt, Vedische Mythologie, 1, 250, 261, 527.
